name: Future Doll
source:
One morning an android girl bursts into main character's apartment. Hero is a very lucky man - he is chosen out of million people to test new bio android prototype "Future Doll". This special android type adapts to master's character and can perform all wife duties. The testing period is 30 days, but if it is a success, hero can get himself a wife forever.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一天早晨，一名仿生人少女突然闯进主人公的公寓。主人公实在幸运：他从一百万人中脱颖而出，获选测试新型仿生人原型“未来人形”。这种特殊的仿生人会适应主人的性格，还能承担妻子的全部职责。测试期为30天；如果测试成功，主人公就能永远拥有一位妻子。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
